verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a SaaS incident-management platform, but the evidence pack never documents retention periods, deletion workflows, or purge controls. The nearest items are adjacent features: AI opt-in and per-feature toggles (rootly-docs-82), choosing which AI SRE memory notes are recalled (rootly-docs-85), and the anonymized-speaker flag on recordings (rootly-docs-115). None of these is control over how long data is kept or how it is deleted, so none earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
